supersedes: v1 blocked_preconditions_unmet record (same path), written before the reviewer source pack was supplied
purpose: Reviewer-owned assignment record for Wave-C shard A. Four families were reviewed end to end against real official source bytes and page-by-page visual inspection. The scope caveats below are recorded because they change what this review does and does not establish; they were not worked around.

assignmentBasis.explanation: The assignment specifies deriving a 16-family denominator at base e94fb456 and taking slice [0:4]. That derivation remains impossible in this repository (see scopeCaveats). The four families below were instead named explicitly by the reviewer source pack manifest (rcap-wave-c-review-source-pack/v1, shard a, familyCount 4). This review therefore verifies those four families on their own evidence; it does not establish that they are the correct slice of a 16-family denominator.

corpus.note: The pack is explicit that it is a four-PDF review-input pack, not the 499-file Master Library. Every source byte needed for these four families is present and hash-verified; nothing beyond them is.

scopeCaveats.detail: The assignment and the pack both pin base commit e94fb456. That commit is not a valid git object in this repository and is absent from all refs. Review was performed against the artifacts as committed at HEAD ef957a9 (reviewer records added on top). Every hash in verdicts.json was recomputed from the bytes actually on disk, so the verdicts describe the artifacts reviewed, whatever commit they are labelled with.

No all-page evidence package, raster manifest, or source-backed rerender record exists at this HEAD, and the sidecar schema rcap-artifact-provenance/v1 has no key able to express them. The denominator predicates therefore remain underivable and the required count of exactly 16 reviewable families could not be checked.

The repository carries 9 contact sheets, all page-01, for 63 families. All-page visual evidence for this review was generated by the reviewer (pypdfium2 scale=2.0) rather than read from a committed raster manifest. Reviewer raster SHA-256 values are pinned per family in verdicts.json so the inspection is reproducible.

field-classification.json exists on disk for all four families but every sidecar pins classificationSha256: null. The reviewer recomputed and pinned the classification file hash independently. Ownership was not left ambiguous for these four: all four are AcroForm families with a full nine-class classification on disk, so the relaxed flat-overlay allowance in the assignment did not need to be relied on.

sidecar fieldMapSha256 does not hash production-field-map.json. It hashes JSON.stringify of the derived bindings array alone (scripts/implement-rcap-official-forms-d1.mjs:644 passes bindings; rcap-artifact-provenance.mjs:120 hashes it). All four reproduce exactly under that referent. Recorded because the key name invites a false mismatch finding on recomputation; not a defect.

historicalObjections.detail: No prior independent-review wave records, correction records, or provenAgainstThisFamilysBytes flags exist at this HEAD for any of the four families. Step 6 had no input. No historical verdict was edited, because none exists.
